title: Localisation operating model
description: A working model for carrying editorial intent across languages while keeping local judgement close to the audience.
note: Explores clearer review paths, explicit quality signals, and fewer invisible hand-offs.

title: Editorial decision log
description: A lightweight record for the small content decisions that are easy to make and surprisingly hard to explain later.
note: Tests whether visible context can reduce repeated debates without creating another reporting ritual.

title: Market launch field notes
description: A practical framework for observing how a central proposition changes when it meets local media habits and constraints.
note: Organises questions for teams before execution hardens assumptions into process.
